ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Ready to Promote and Promote and Deploy while a verification is running.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Story_Verification_Control__c.Disable_Story_Verification__c), OR( AND(copado__Promote_Change__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_Change__c))), AND(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c))) ), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Running") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Verification is in progress. Promote is available once verification completes with a Clean result.
